# Own method parameters and receiver parameters have independent effects.
# Go providers emit both masks, even on non-generic receivers. Ordinary
# definitions remain legal; a selected assertion target is checked only
# when concrete arguments instantiate it. The positive case covers a
# qualified receiver with an assertion on an unrelated method parameter,
# known-zero generic methods, ordinary assertions, and a qualified unused
# method parameter with an asserting (but concrete int) receiver.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd good
logos build -o good$GOEXE .
exec ./good$GOEXE
cd ..

cd plain
! logos build .
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
cd ..

cd method
! logos build .
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
cd ..

cd receiver
! logos build .
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
cd ..

-- lib/go.mod --
module example/methodlib

go 1.27

-- lib/lib.go --
package methodlib

type Plain struct{}

func (Plain) Identity[U any](v U) U { return v }
func (Plain) As[U any](v any) U { return v.(U) }

type Box[T any] struct{ V T }

func (Box[T]) Identity[U any](v U) U { return v }
func (Box[T]) As[U any](v any) U { return v.(U) }

type ReceiverBox[T any] struct{ V T }

func (ReceiverBox[T]) Receiver[U any](v any) T { return v.(T) }

-- good/go.mod --
module example/good

go 1.27

require example/methodlib v0.0.0

replace example/methodlib => ../lib

-- plain/go.mod --
module example/plain

go 1.27

require example/methodlib v0.0.0

replace example/methodlib => ../lib

-- method/go.mod --
module example/method

go 1.27

require example/methodlib v0.0.0

replace example/methodlib => ../lib

-- receiver/go.mod --
module example/receiver

go 1.27

require example/methodlib v0.0.0

replace example/methodlib => ../lib

-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import "example/methodlib"

type Qualified interface { const Name() string }
type Good struct{}
func (Good) Name() string { return "good" }

func main() {
	var q Qualified = Good{}
	box := methodlib.Box[Qualified]{V: q}
	if box.Identity[Qualified](q).Name() != "good" {
		panic("receiver-qualified identity")
	}
	if (methodlib.Plain{}).Identity[Qualified](q).Name() != "good" {
		panic("non-generic receiver identity")
	}
	if box.As[int](42) != 42 || (methodlib.Plain{}).As[int](42) != 42 {
		panic("ordinary assertion")
	}
	if (methodlib.ReceiverBox[int]{}).Receiver[Qualified](42) != 42 {
		panic("independent receiver and own masks")
	}
}

-- plain/main.lgo --
package main

import "example/methodlib"

type Qualified interface { const Name() string }
type Bad struct{ N int }
func (b *Bad) Name() string { b.N++; return "bad" }

func main() {
	_ = (methodlib.Plain{}).As[Qualified](any(&Bad{}))
}

-- method/main.lgo --
package main

import "example/methodlib"

type Qualified interface { const Name() string }
type Bad struct{ N int }
func (b *Bad) Name() string { b.N++; return "bad" }

func main() {
	_ = methodlib.Box[int]{}.As[Qualified](any(&Bad{}))
}

-- receiver/main.lgo --
package main

import "example/methodlib"

type Qualified interface { const Name() string }
type Bad struct{ N int }
func (b *Bad) Name() string { b.N++; return "bad" }

func main() {
	_ = methodlib.ReceiverBox[Qualified]{}.Receiver[int](any(&Bad{}))
}
